title: Customer Standing Terms: Standing Reduction on the Rental Vehicle Coordination Self-Pay Charge
content:
**Standing term.** The standing reduction on the self-pay charge of a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental follows the renter's standing with the network: a renter who holds an active network workmanship warranty and has an estimate booking converted into a repair takes 10 percent; a renter meeting exactly one of the two takes 5 percent; any other renter takes zero. The self-pay charge is the priced self-pay days reduced by the standing reduction percent, rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Records read

- Whether the renter holds a coverage under Workmanship Warranties whose status is active.
- Whether any estimate booking of the renter under Repair Estimates & Appointments stands as converted into a repair.

## Reduction table

| Active coverage under Workmanship Warranties | Estimate booking converted into a repair | Standing reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 10 percent |
| Yes | No | 5 percent |
| No | Yes | 5 percent |
| No | No | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- Self-pay days priced at 211.96 USD for a renter with both: reduced by 10 percent, 190.764 USD, rounded once at the end to 190.76 USD.
- The same priced days for a renter with only an active warranty coverage: reduced by 5 percent, 201.362 USD, rounded to 201.36 USD.
- A renter whose warranty coverage has expired and who never converted a booking: 211.96 USD.
